notes.title: 🔮 Wich Please — Coming Soon to Steam! 💋🧪
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44911523/1c048fad7c8bb6e6376dc661854479f5d93c2d3a.png[/img]

Alchemy, lust, and a touch of magic — in a spicy new visual novel for adults.
Wich Please is an erotic 2D visual novel with potion-brewing mechanics and light ingredient collection.  Expect a rich story, unforgettable characters, and a generous dose of NSFW content — everything you need to get properly stirred.

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44911523/ec0a82f92a5597bfe31711c0c96d6ba1202c39b4.png[/img]

[h1]🧙‍♀️ WHAT’S THE STORY?[/h1]
You play as Gwen, a young witch who returns to her hometown of Aquilon after her father’s death — only to inherit:  – a crumbling potion shop,  – a crushing debt to a powerful noblewoman,  – and a dusty old alchemical grimoire.
To survive, Gwen will need to learn potioncraft, gather ingredients, deal with some very unusual characters…  and uncover the truth hidden behind her father's legacy.  There’s only one path — but it’s bold, steamy, and full of secrets.

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44911523/e597665c47149e6d7df468913938179caafda368.png[/img]
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44911523/85828a3eed3e6f91d4250f0955991031f5284b7a.png[/img]

[h1]🧪 FEATURES[/h1]
💋 A linear erotic visual novel with strong narrative and immersive worldbuilding  🧪 Simple, story-driven ingredient gathering and potion-brewing mechanics  🎭 Memorable, well-developed characters — each with their own desires, flaws, and secrets  🐾 A talking black cat — sarcastic, jealous, and disturbingly observant  💦 Over 10 animated NSFW scenes with sound and 2D effects  📚 Alchemy, humor, intrigue, sex, and a pinch of drama — all brewed into one magical bottle

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44911523/46252ff3f421eb5c857653faf4b44b61da1ec42b.png[/img]
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44911523/69a93f2cb727dcffdc22df8956459b16ea0f59fb.png[/img]

[h1]🧡 WHO IS THIS GAME FOR?[/h1]

[b]Ren[/b] – A pragmatic and calculating yet kind-hearted guy, always willing to lend a helping hand to those in need.
[b]Yuna[/b] – A strong and brave young woman who has sacrificed herself for her family but refuses to accept her fate.

Your choices in dialogue shape the story’s progression and its ending.
